title: Inbound Entry Points: Route Calls and Texts to the Right Queue | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A phone number does nothing on its own: someone has to decide who answers, and what happens at night or on a holiday. An inbound entry point is the front door of a number. It routes calls and texts to a queue or a person, follows your business hours, and sends callers to voicemail when nobody can answer.

In this video:
• Why numbers need an entry point, and how numbers, routing, hours and voicemail fit together
• Adding the numbers under Omnichannel Addresses
• Creating a call entry point: name, numbers, queue and priority
• Closed hours: the business hours calendar, the closed action and the closed message
• Voicemail: the default greeting and whose inbox receives the message
• A personal line that rings one agent
• Text entry points with queue distribution, an auto-reply and a closed auto-reply
• Cloning an entry point, and a checklist to test a number before you publish it
